title: [R2] handleStateEvent race condition fix is ineffective
description:
When messageState is null and both changed.Message and changed.Chat are present in the same event, the fix sets messageState but then calls Message/changes in the same cycle, violating the fix's intent to skip the Message call when catching up. State tokens from events (changed.Message) are not equivalent to state tokens from Message/get results.

The issue: lines 533-536 set messageState but don't prevent line 540-541 from calling Message/changes.

Fix should be: when messageState was null, DON'T call Message/changes on that same event. Only sync the state token and process any Chat changes. Message/changes should wait for the next event.
